items.question: 2026 年一季度全库客户买入金额的逐月走势如何?(月份用 YYYYMM 表示)
items.gold_sql: SELECT substr(data_dt,1,6) AS 月份, ROUND(SUM(buy_amt),2) AS 买入金额 FROM dwd_cust_tran_d WHERE data_dt BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20260331' GROUP BY substr(data_dt,1,6) ORDER BY 月份
items.caliber_notes: 逐月趋势: 月份=substr(data_dt,1,6) 取 YYYYMM; 交易额=buy_amt; 区间 20260101~20260331。

items.question: 2026 年一季度全库客户交易笔数(买入+卖出)的逐月走势如何?(月份用 YYYYMM 表示)
items.gold_sql: SELECT substr(data_dt,1,6) AS 月份, SUM(buy_cnt+sell_cnt) AS 交易笔数 FROM dwd_cust_tran_d WHERE data_dt BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20260331' GROUP BY substr(data_dt,1,6) ORDER BY 月份
items.caliber_notes: 逐月趋势: 月份=substr(data_dt,1,6); 交易笔数=buy_cnt+sell_cnt; 区间 20260101~20260331。

items.question: 列出 2026-03-31 持有开放式基金(一级分类 PT050000)的客户号,最多 20 个
items.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT h.pty_id AS 客户号 FROM dwd_cust_hold_d h JOIN dim_product d ON h.prdt_id=d.prdt_id WHERE h.data_dt='20260331' AND d.up_prdt_type_id='PT050000' AND h.hold_cnt>0 ORDER BY h.pty_id LIMIT 20
items.caliber_notes: 明细: 问'哪些客户'输出客户号 pty_id; 持有=hold_cnt>0; 一级分类用 up_prdt_type_id='PT050000'; 最多 20 个, 按客户号排序。

items.question: 列出 2026-03-31 持有比亚迪相关产品的客户号,最多 20 个
items.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT h.pty_id AS 客户号 FROM dwd_cust_hold_d h JOIN dim_product d ON h.prdt_id=d.prdt_id WHERE h.data_dt='20260331' AND d.prdt_name LIKE '%比亚迪%' AND h.hold_cnt>0 ORDER BY h.pty_id LIMIT 20
items.caliber_notes: 明细: 输出客户号 pty_id; 产品名 LIKE '%比亚迪%'; 持有=hold_cnt>0; 最多 20 个, 按客户号排序。

items.question: 分析 2026 年一季度全库客户的资金净流入合计(流入-流出)是多少?
items.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(cash_in+tran_in+assign_in-cash_out-tran_out-assign_out),2) AS 资金净流入合计 FROM dws_cust_fin_d WHERE data_dt BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20260331'
items.caliber_notes: 分析: 净流入=流入-流出; 流入=cash_in+tran_in+assign_in, 流出=cash_out+tran_out+assign_out; 区间 20260101~20260331。

items.question: 分析 2026 年一季度全库客户的买入佣金合计占买入金额的比例是多少?(输出列名用 佣金占比, 保留 6 位小数)
items.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(buy_rake)*1.0/SUM(buy_amt),6) AS 佣金占比 FROM dwd_cust_tran_d WHERE data_dt BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20260331'
items.caliber_notes: 分析: 买入佣金占比=SUM(buy_rake)/SUM(buy_amt); 区间 20260101~20260331; 输出列名用 佣金占比。
